#!/usr/bin/env bash
# User115 Nov13. Full-model coordinate Lion mechanical256, not quality training.
# Expected20 to30 minutes. Same source/exposure/gain/noise as AdamW.
# Includes all finite/sparse prevalidation cost; no CP save or teacher call.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
PY="$(tinylm_python)"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage4fu6Wb_coordinate_lion256 -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 3650s "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m scripts.diag_p106b_gsq_coordinate_window run --arm lion
